title: Flying Domestic in NZ with Kids — Air NZ Tips, Baggage, and Seat Selection
meta_desc: Flying domestic in NZ with kids? Learn Air NZ tips, baggage rules, and seat selection to make your family trip smoother
intro: With over 400 domestic flights per day, Air NZ is the most convenient way to travel around New Zealand with your family. However, navigating baggage allowances and seat selection can be a challenge. In this article, we will break down the essentials of flying domestic in NZ with kids.

sections.heading: Air NZ Domestic Baggage Allowance
sections.body: When flying with kids, it's essential to know the baggage allowance to avoid any last-minute surprises. Air NZ offers a standard baggage allowance of 1 piece of checked luggage up to 23kg for adults and children, and 1 piece of carry-on luggage up to 7kg.

sections.heading: Family Seating Options
list: Book seats together in advance to ensure your family is seated together (fee applies: $10-$30 per seat)
Opt for an Air NZ Skycouch, which can accommodate up to 3 children (price starts at $699 for a one-way fare)
Consider booking a bulkhead seat for more legroom (fee applies: $20-$50 per seat)

sections.heading: Booking and Check-in
sections.body: To book your domestic flight, visit the Air NZ website (airnewzealand.co.nz) or use their mobile app. Online check-in is available 24 hours prior to your flight, and you can select your seats and print or download your boarding pass.

sections.heading: Tips for Flying with Kids
list: Book a morning flight to avoid peak travel times
Pack snacks and entertainment for your kids
Consider booking a flight with a shorter travel time to reduce the risk of meltdowns

cta.text: Use our NZ Family Travel Budget Calculator

sections.heading: Accommodation Options
sections.body: After arriving at your destination, you'll need a place to stay. Our website has a range of accommodation options, from hotels to campervans. Visit our campervan page to learn more about renting a campervan for your family trip.
